meta.title: Jury Panel
meta.description: Who scores Gridliners entries, what they are responsible for, and the published framework every entry is judged through.

header.title: The jury panel
header.lead: Every entry is scored by the jurors assigned to its category, against criteria published before the cycle opens.

judging.title: How judging works
judging.scaleBody: Each assigned juror scores an entry from 0 to 100 against every criterion in its parent category.
judging.criteriaBody: Each parent category has its own criteria and its own weights. They are published here before the cycle opens, and they do not change inside a cycle.
judging.thresholdBody: An entry that reaches its tier threshold becomes Shortlisted, and its maker becomes a Cadet.
judging.rankBody: Jury scoring decides who is shortlisted. Final placing inside a group is decided by public vote, with the jury score used only to break a tie.
judging.frameworkTitle: The sheet a juror fills in
judging.frameworkBody: One of these for every entry, completed by each juror assigned to its category. They mark each line, the marks are added up, and that total is the score.

fairness.title: Judged through the same frame
fairness.body: Students, freelancers and companies are kept fully separate. An entry is only ever compared with entries in its own tier, so no one is measured against a studio with a different budget or a different decade of practice.
fairness.note: The three are equal in every way but the pool they sit in. Each has its own shortlist threshold because each is measured inside itself, not against the others.
fairness.reasoning: Criteria and the reasoning behind a score stay attached to the entry and are published with the result.

panel.title: Who judges what
panel.description: A juror is assigned at parent-category level and inherits every sub-category under it. These are the parents each of them scores.

process.title: How the panel is run
process.assignmentBody: Jurors are assigned at parent-category level and inherit all of its sub-categories. Nobody scores a category they are not assigned to.
process.completeBody: A result stays pending until every juror assigned to that category has scored it. If a juror never does, the awards team enters the missing score on their behalf and the entry records that it was entered that way.
process.ndaBody: Jurors sign one before they see any entry. Entries, scores and reasoning stay inside the panel until results are announced.
process.recatBody: A juror or the awards team may move an entry to a more suitable category, but only during Tier Verification and only before jury scoring opens. The participant is notified when it happens. Once scoring has opened, nothing moves.

closing.title: Judged by people who do this work
closing.body: The framework is published, the panel is named, and the criteria are the same for everyone in your tier.

s3.creditsHint: One per line: name, and what they did.

s4.lead: A square cover, the gallery in the order you want it read, and anything the images cannot carry.
s4.coverHint: One image, square. This represents the project everywhere on the site.
s4.galleryHint: Up to 8 images, JPEG or PNG, 8 MB each.
s4.videoHint: A link to the film. We do not host video.
s4.mockBody: Files are held in this browser session and are not sent anywhere. Nothing here claims a file was stored when it was not.

s5.lead: Everything you have entered, and what it costs. Nothing is charged until the next step.
s5.acceptTerms: I accept the Terms & Conditions and confirm this work is mine to enter.
s5.acceptRequired: You have to accept the terms before paying.
s5.quoteNote: This quote is frozen at checkout. A later window change never re-prices it.

s6.lead: How you would like to pay.
s6.cardBody: Pay now and your entry is submitted immediately.
s6.cashBody: We issue a reference. Your entry is reserved but is not judged until we confirm the payment.

s6.expiryNote: A cash reference expires after {days} days.

errors.proofRequired: This proof is required for the tier you chose.
errors.urlInvalid: That does not look like a web address.
errors.termsRequired: You have to accept the terms.
errors.notDraft: This entry has been submitted and can no longer be edited.
errors.saveFailed: That did not save. Try again.

wizard.lockedTitle: This entry is no longer editable
wizard.lockedBody: It has been submitted, so it is a record now. Open it to see where it stands.
wizard.newLead: Six steps. Your draft saves as you go, so you can leave and come back.

checkout.successLead: That is it. Your entry is in the cycle.
checkout.pendingLead: Your entry is reserved. It enters judging when we confirm the payment.
checkout.failedLead: Nothing was charged. You can try again from the entry.
checkout.expiredLead: The cash reference lapsed before it was paid, so the entry was cancelled.
checkout.nextSubmitted: We verify your tier against the proofs you gave. Assigned jurors then score the work against its category's criteria. You will hear from us at each step.
checkout.nextCash: Take the reference to the awards office or transfer against it. Your entry is not judged until we confirm receipt, and the reference expires on the date above.
checkout.mockNote: This payment is a mock. No card was charged and no card details were collected or stored.
checkout.alreadyBody: This entry was submitted earlier. Refreshing this page does not submit or charge again.

awards.title: My Awards
awards.lead: Everything you have been given, and the files that come with it.
awards.finalistLead: Shortlisted projects carry the blue finalist badge.
awards.emptyBody: Awards appear here once a cycle's results are published. Shortlisted projects get their finalist badge as soon as the shortlist is announced.
awards.provisionalBody: The certificate, the badge and the package are generated for review from your own record. The final printed certificate is issued by the awards office.
awards.fileCertificateWhat: The provisional certificate for this award.
awards.fileBadgeWhat: The award badge, for your own site.
awards.filePackageWhat: The certificate, the badge, the snippet and a readme.

meta.title: Awards
meta.description: The Gridliners Awards: the story, the timetable, the categories, the fees and how to enter.

awardsHub.title: Everything the awards are
awardsHub.lead: One cycle a year, judged by a jury and decided in public voting. Start here, then follow whichever part you came for.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Gridliners celebrates the region's best design work. Entries are judged by an independent jury, shortlisted per group, and the medals are decided by public vote.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: Every category, and the groups inside it. A project can be entered in more than one, and can hold a medal in each.

fees.title: Fees and deadlines
fees.body: One fee per entry, set by tier and by how early you enter. Students pay the lowest of the three.

enter.title: How to enter
enter.body: Create an account, describe the work, choose its groups and pay. Six steps, and a draft you can leave and come back to.

benefits.title: Why enter
benefits.body: A jury read of your work, a public page for the project, and a hosted record of any award it wins.

awardsHub.record: Every medal and honorary designation gets a page of its own, which the winner can link to.

closing.title: The next edition is open
closing.body: Entries are judged in the group you choose, so pick carefully and enter early.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: Your account, and how the interface behaves.
profile.name: Full name
profile.photoHint: A portrait or a company logo. Square works best.
profile.emailChanged: Your sign-in address is changed too.

errors.email_taken: An account already uses that address.
errors.server_error: Something failed at our end. Try again.

profile.identityLead: How you are named on entries, certificates and your public project pages.
profile.securityLead: Changing your password signs you out of nothing else. It is a separate submission from the details above.

billing.title: Billing
billing.lead: Every payment on your account, with the pricing that was frozen at the time.
billing.noSnapshot: No pricing snapshot on this payment.
billing.snapshotNote: This is what was quoted at checkout. It is never recalculated.
billing.noneBody: Payments appear here when you check out an entry.

votes.title: My Votes
votes.lead: Projects you have voted for with this account's email address.
votes.noneBody: When you vote for a project during the public voting window, it appears here.
